integrity: The recent primary source was inspected in full text at its non-coplanar theorem, projection proof, examples, and application section.
The one-dimensional classification was checked against Łaba's theorem statement in the primary paper.
The numerical artifact is only a finite regression check and is not used to justify the infinite classification.
No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only spectra contained in an affine line are classified; non-coplanar two-segment measures may also have nonlinear spectra.
The proof depends on established projection, uniformity, and two-interval spectral-classification theorems rather than replacing those results.
No equivalent published corollary was found under the searched terminology, but equivalent formulations under different notation cannot be excluded absolutely.
title: Complete line-spectrum dichotomy for weighted skew segments
